item.title: Building Your First REST API with Node.js and Express
item.description:
Building REST APIs is a fundamental skill for modern web developers. In this tutorial, we’ll create a complete REST API using Node.js and Express, perfect for beginners who want to understand backend development.

What You’ll Learn

By the end of this tutorial, you’ll have built a functional REST API that can:

  • Handle GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE requests
  • Manage data with proper error handling
  • Implement middleware for logging and validation
  • Structure your project for scalability

item.title: Fueling Philly's Tech Future: Code & Coffee's Innovation Engine
item.description: Philadelphia’s technology scene features communities fostering growth and innovation. Code & Coffee Philadelphia, a non-profit, energizes this ecosystem. Their “Philly Innovation Hackathon 2025” during Philly Tech Week brought together innovators to solve challenges. This event reflects Code & Coffee’s mission to connect, educate, and empower local tech talent. Blog Content Management Guide This guide explains how to create and manage blog posts for the Code & Coffee Philadelphia website using Hugo’s page bundles. Hugo Page Bundles Hugo supports “page bundles” which allow you to organize content and assets together in folders. This makes it easier to manage blog posts with images and other resources. Blog Post Structure Each blog post should be in its own folder with an index.

item.title: Project Request
item.description: Got a coding challenge you’re stuck on? Working on an exciting project that could use some extra hands? Code & Coffee Philadelphia is here to help! Our community is full of talented developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts who love collaborating and sharing knowledge. Whether you’re a beginner looking for guidance or an experienced developer seeking feedback, we welcome project requests of all kinds. From debugging sessions to architectural advice, our community members are eager to contribute their expertise.

item.title: Tech Talent Matchboard
item.description: Looking to connect with talented developers, designers, and tech professionals in Philadelphia? Or maybe you’re seeking new opportunities in the local tech scene? Our Tech Talent Matchboard is designed to bring together the best minds in Philly’s growing technology ecosystem. Whether you’re a company looking for skilled professionals, a freelancer seeking projects, or a developer wanting to network and collaborate, this platform helps facilitate meaningful connections within our community.
